name: Vonn
source:
Vonn is the second of the brothers at around 22 years of age. He tends to be a grump about everything, but he does have a sweet and funny side to him. He’s rarely a talkative person, but when he does talk, it can be pretty hard to shut him up.

(Taken from [url=https://ainoshiki.wordpress.com/games/once-upon-a-hallows-eve/]dev page[/url])
